or support by buying my other assets here,or giving a tip on loafbrr.itch.io 

INSTRUCTIONS: 
Circle Objects
-get copy attributes add-on to easily copy modifiers for making round objects. NOTE this only works with objects 3 meters in length, 
-move object to the round set location, feel free to adjust it vertically so you can see the object
-select the moved object, press shift select the rounded object, hit ctrl + c, pick copy selected modifiers, get array and simple deform and ok,
-IF object is not a wall, maybe something like a torch, copy the pillars modifiers.
-Duplicate the object -> apply modifiers and move it somewhere safe

Vertex Color Export (if you dont have addon for to export stuff):
-File -> Export > fbx or gltf > press "n" if the side panel on the right is not there
-under the mesh, tick attributes, and under vertex colors, Select Name under Use Vertex Color and put the name of the Color attribute on there,
-NOTE: if vertex color dont export, do the good old trial and error between Active Material and Name.
